body.x: 'ACEN' has been chosen in advance of the 'BEST OF MIK CES TOP10', scheduled to participate in 'CES 2018 (Consumer Technology Show)', the world's largest IT exhibition, that will take place in Las Vegas, the USA from 9th to 12th of January.

Founded in July 2003, ACEN is a professional company for the measurement and analysis of gas component. They will introduce smart city solution, air quality measuring systems and smart breathalyser at CES.

In order to prevent air pollution, the most important process is to measure accurately and analyse airborne contaminants or toxic components of the fine dust. Hee Nam, Song, the head of ACEN, localised the gas chromatograph machine for the first time.

Also, ACEN was selected as managing department for the project of Green patrol with Ministry of Environment in South Korea, which is for localisation of environment measuring equipment and development work of export products. They have researched and developed field measuring system for odour and Volatile Organic Compounds.
With the approval of their Air Total monitoring technology by the Chinese ministry of environmental protection, ACEN is on the brink of the entry to the huge Chinese market.

An official said,” we are going to make progress in revenue by developing a management system for measuring odour and providing resolution, a measuring solution for fine dust and hazmat, and a health examination system management by gas analysis of human respiratory.”

ACEN was chosen as the winner of the air measurement monitoring category this year among the world`s top 100 environmental technology organized by the Chinese Environmental Protection department. Acknowledged their superiority in the system, they were awarded for 2017 Korea's Green Technology and Green Product and won the prize by the ministry of Environment and of Trade, Industry, and Energy.

Meanwhile, “BEST OF MADE IN KOREA CES TOP10” selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 exhibitors by Aving News and foreign reporters such as the US and China considering the trend of the company, growth rate, and prospects. During the exhibition period, each media will select the TOP 3 through final screening and announce it officially on the last day of the exhibition.

CES, the world's largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
